mapper.sql: l.id, l.applicant_user_id AS applicantUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(applicant.display_name, ''), applicant.username) AS applicantName, l.approver_user_id AS approverUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(approver.display_name, ''), approver.username) AS approverName, l.leave_type AS leaveType, l.start_date AS startDate, l.start_period AS startPeriod, l.end_date AS endDate, l.end_period AS endPeriod, l.duration_half_days AS durationHalfDays, l.reason, l.status, l.version, task.id AS taskId, task.version AS taskVersion, task.status AS taskStatus, task.due_at AS taskDueAt, instance.status AS workflowStatus, l.submitted_at AS submittedAt, l.completed_at AS completedAt, l.created_at AS createdAt, l.updated_at AS updatedAt, applicant.avatar AS applicantAvatar, applicant.updated_at AS applicantUpdatedAt, approver.avatar AS approverAvatar, approver.updated_at AS approverUpdatedAt

JOIN app_user applicant ON applicant.id = l.applicant_user_id LEFT JOIN app_user approver ON approver.id = l.approver_user_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT wt.id, wt.version, wt.status, wt.due_at FROM workflow_task wt WHERE wt.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND wt.business_type = 'LEAVE_APPLICATION' AND wt.business_id = l.id ORDER BY wt.created_at DESC, wt.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) task ON TRUE LEFT JOIN workflow_instance instance ON instance.id = l.workflow_instance_id AND instance.tenant_id = l.tenant_id
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM leave_application WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY status

SELECT candidate_id FROM ( SELECT direct.id AS candidate_id, 1 AS priority FROM app_user applicant JOIN app_user direct ON direct.id = applicant.approver_user_id AND direct.tenant_id = applicant.tenant_id AND direct.status = 1 WHERE applicant.id = #{applicantId} AND applicant.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND direct.id <> applicant.id AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur JOIN rbac_role_permission rp ON rp.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND rp.role_code = ur.role_code AND rp.permission_code = 'approval:act' WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = direct.id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = direct.id AND ur.role_code = 'SUPER_ADMIN' ) ) UNION ALL SELECT fallback_user.id AS candidate_id, 2 AS priority FROM app_user applicant JOIN department d ON d.id = applicant.department_id AND d.tenant_id = applicant.tenant_id AND d.status = 1 JOIN app_user fallback_user ON fallback_user.id = d.default_approver_user_id AND fallback_user.tenant_id = applicant.tenant_id AND fallback_user.status = 1 WHERE applicant.id = #{applicantId} AND applicant.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND fallback_user.id <> applicant.id AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur JOIN rbac_role_permission rp ON rp.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND rp.role_code = ur.role_code AND rp.permission_code = 'approval:act' WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = fallback_user.id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = fallback_user.id AND ur.role_code = 'SUPER_ADMIN' ) ) ) candidates ORDER BY priority LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM workflow_definition WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND code = 'LEAVE_SINGLE_APPROVAL' AND enabled = TRUE ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE applicant_department AS ( SELECT department_id FROM app_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{applicantId} ), department_chain AS ( SELECT d.id, d.parent_id, 0 AS depth FROM department d JOIN applicant_department ad ON ad.department_id = d.id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.status = 1 UNION ALL SELECT parent.id, parent.parent_id, chain.depth + 1 FROM department parent JOIN department_chain chain ON chain.parent_id = parent.id WHERE parent.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND parent.status = 1 ), eligible_raw AS ( SELECT u.id, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.display_name, ''), u.username) AS name, d.name AS department_name, p.name AS position_name, chain.depth, u.avatar, u.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM app_user u JOIN department_chain chain ON chain.id = u.department_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND d.id = u.department_id LEFT JOIN position p ON p.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND p.id = u.position_id WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.status = 1 AND u.id <> #{applicantId} AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur JOIN rbac_role_permission rp ON rp.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND rp.role_code = ur.role_code AND rp.permission_code = 'approval:act' WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = u.id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.role_code = 'SUPER_ADMIN' ) ) UNION ALL SELECT u.id, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.display_name, ''), u.username) AS name, d.name AS department_name, p.name AS position_name, -1 AS depth, u.avatar, u.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM app_user applicant JOIN app_user u ON u.id = applicant.approver_user_id AND u.tenant_id = applicant.tenant_id AND u.status = 1 AND u.id <> applicant.id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND d.id = u.department_id LEFT JOIN position p ON p.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND p.id = u.position_id WHERE applicant.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND applicant.id = #{applicantId} AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur JOIN rbac_role_permission rp ON rp.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND rp.role_code = ur.role_code AND rp.permission_code = 'approval:act' WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = u.id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.role_code = 'SUPER_ADMIN' ) ) UNION ALL SELECT u.id, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.display_name, ''), u.username) AS name, d.name AS department_name, p.name AS position_name, 998 AS depth, u.avatar, u.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM app_user applicant JOIN department dept ON dept.id = applicant.department_id AND dept.tenant_id = applicant.tenant_id AND dept.status = 1 JOIN app_user u ON u.id = dept.default_approver_user_id AND u.tenant_id = applicant.tenant_id AND u.status = 1 AND u.id <> applicant.id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND d.id = u.department_id LEFT JOIN position p ON p.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND p.id = u.position_id WHERE applicant.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND applicant.id = #{applicantId} AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur JOIN rbac_role_permission rp ON rp.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND rp.role_code = ur.role_code AND rp.permission_code = 'approval:act' WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = u.id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.role_code = 'SUPER_ADMIN' ) ) ), eligible AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, name, department_name, position_name, depth, avatar, updatedAt FROM eligible_raw ORDER BY id, depth )
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible
WHERE name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(department_name, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(position_name, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible WHERE id = #{approverId}

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(applicant.display_name, ''), applicant.username) AS applicantName, department.name AS departmentName, position.name AS positionName, COALESCE(NULLIF(approver.display_name, ''), approver.username) AS approverName, applicant.avatar AS applicantAvatar, applicant.updated_at AS applicantUpdatedAt FROM app_user applicant LEFT JOIN department ON department.id = applicant.department_id AND department.tenant_id = applicant.tenant_id LEFT JOIN position ON position.id = applicant.position_id AND position.tenant_id = applicant.tenant_id LEFT JOIN app_user approver ON approver.id = #{approverId} AND approver.tenant_id = applicant.tenant_id WHERE applicant.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND applicant.id = #{applicantId}
